path.description: Exllama 4-bit GEMM: GPTQ, AutoGPTQ and compressed-tensors wNa16 linear layers when ExllamaLinearKernel is selected. It is sixth in the CUDA priority list (CutlassW4A8, Machete, AllSpark, Marlin, Conch, Exllama, ...), so it is reached only when every earlier kernel cannot implement the layer or is disabled through VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS. exllama.py always passes use_exllama=True. K is split across blockIdx.z and every z-block atomically adds its fp16 partial into the output; used only when size_m <= 50 (24 for 8-bit), larger M reconstructs the weight and calls cuBLAS.

evidence.claim: atomicAdd(out, result01); atomicAdd(out + 1, result23) on half2 output
_POSSIBLE_KERNELS[CUDA] order: CutlassW4A8, Machete, AllSpark, Marlin, Conch, Exllama, TritonW4A16, Humming; choose_mp_linear_kernel returns the first that can_implement
ops.gptq_gemm(x_2d, w_q, w_zp, w_s, w_g_idx, True, use_v2_format, bits): use_exllama is hard-coded True
gridDim.z = DIVIDE(size_k, BLOCK_KN_SIZE): the K dimension is split across blocks
offset_k = blockIdx.z * BLOCK_KN_SIZE: each z-block handles one K chunk of the same output tile
use_reconstruct when size_m > MAX_Q_GEMM_ROWS (50) or > MAX_Q_GEMM_ROWS_8BIT (24); otherwise the atomic kernel runs
VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS defaults to an empty list

notes: This is the kernel Cankaya 2026 identified (q_gemm.cu:319-320 in vLLM 0.11.2). Not on the default path at this sha because Marlin (and Machete on sm90+) precede it in the kernel priority list; it is reached when those are disabled or cannot implement the layer.

path.description: MoE wNa16 CUDA kernel: for every (token, expert) pair in a sorted block, the expert's partial output (scaled by the routing weight when mul_topk_weight) is atomically added into the token's output row. The top-k experts of one token therefore accumulate in arrival order. Selected when bit == 4, group size in {32, 64, 128} and num_valid_tokens / num_experts <= 6, i.e. decode-sized batches; larger batches use the Triton fused_moe kernel, which stores. Reached by --quantization moe_wna16, by AutoGPTQ/AutoAWQ MoE layers that Marlin MoE cannot handle, and by compressed-tensors wNa16 MoE layers without Marlin support.

evidence.claim: atomicAdd(&output[token_index * size_n + offset_n], Dtype::float2num(res[m])) for every valid token m of the block
res[m] *= topk_weights[token_index] when mul_topk_weight: this is the routed-weight combine, so several experts hit the same token row
should_moe_wna16_use_cuda: CUDA and bit == 4 and group_size in [32, 64, 128] and num_valid_tokens / num_experts <= 6
the Triton alternative writes with tl.store(c_ptrs, accumulator, mask)
AutoGPTQ falls back to MoeWNA16Config when check_moe_marlin_supports_layer fails
CompressedTensorsWNA16MoEMethod calls fused_experts, which reaches the same selection

notes: dtype is the activation type (half or bfloat16 through Dtype::float2num). A plausible source of the INT4 MoE non-determinism Cankaya 2026 saw on Kimi-K2-Thinking: it fires exactly in the decode regime and only for non-Marlin wNa16 MoE layers. Needs the runtime probe in docs/RUNTIME_PROBES.md to confirm which kernel that model selects.

path.description: Ticket counter that assigns each (token, expert) pair its slot in the expert's padded block: rank_post_pad = atomicAdd(&cumsum_buffer[expert], 1); sorted_token_ids[rank_post_pad] = i. The order of tokens within an expert block is therefore arrival order.

downstream.argument: The Triton fused_moe kernel loads each row's token id from sorted_token_ids (fused_moe.py:403-414), computes that row's dot products with tl.dot over K (line 513) and stores the row (lines 288-290); no arithmetic mixes rows, so a permutation of rows within a block changes nothing numerically. The top-k combine moe_sum sums a token's k expert outputs in k order (moe_align_sum_kernels.cu:385-388). The exception is the moe_wna16 CUDA kernel (vllm-0014), whose per-token atomicAdd is order-dependent for its own reason.

evidence.claim: rank_post_pad = atomicAdd(&cumsum_buffer[...], 1); sorted_token_ids[...] = i
offs_token loaded per row from sorted_token_ids
accumulator = tl.dot(a, b, acc=accumulator): per-row K reduction
moe_sum_vec_kernel loops k = 0..TOPK-1 in order

notes: Slot order is non-deterministic but does not feed a float reduction on the Triton, CUTLASS grouped-GEMM or DeepGEMM paths, which are all row-independent. Grouped GEMMs with split-K would change this; none is configured at this sha (see the CUTLASS phase).
